_comment: English texts members see. Copy this file (e.g. tr.json), translate the values and add the language to src/i18n.js. {name} placeholders are filled in by the bot; keys ending in _one / _other are picked by a count.

help.title: 🐾 {name} Bot — Command Guide
help.intro: Here is a list of available slash commands and features:
help.showcase: • Post your {item} in the showcase channel and collect ❤️ to become **{title}**!
help.roles: • Grab platform and notification roles from the role panel.
help.ping: • `/ping` - Shows bot and Discord API latency.
help.welcomeSetup: • `/welcome setup channel:#channel message:[custom_text]` - Welcome channel and template.
help.autoroleSetup: • `/autorole setup role:@Role` - Role given to members on join.
help.modlog: • `/modlog setup·status·disable` - Join/leave, message and moderation log.
help.setup: • `/setup` - Status of every system and what to fix.
help.warn: • `/warn add·list·remove·clear` - Warnings; the staff is alerted at the warning alert level.
